title: Design of novel low-density refractory high entropy alloys for high-temperature applications
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting in a water-cooled copper crucible with commercial purity (99.9%) Ti, Al, V, Nb, and Mo. Each alloy was re-melted 5 times to ensure compositional homogeneity.
